nodes.name: Sync Webhook
nodes.notes: Optional cache-invalidation hook for deployments that serve dashboard pages from a CDN cache. Receives {business_id, paths[]}.

nodes.name: Every 5 minutes
nodes.notes: Safety net for the SLA nudge below. The live surfaces need no polling at all.

nodes.name: Find overdue handovers
nodes.notes: The genuinely useful job on this schedule. A conversation escalated at 4pm and still unanswered at 4:20 needs chasing, and nothing else in the system notices the passage of time.

nodes.name: Re-alert the owner
nodes.notes: request_handover is a no-op on an already-waiting thread, so this changes no state — it exists to re-trigger the notification under a fresh dedupe key.

meta.description: The dashboard does not need syncing in the usual sense — it reads Postgres directly, and the conversation viewer subscribes to Supabase Realtime, so an inbound SMS appears without any workflow involvement. This workflow covers the two things that genuinely need a scheduler: chasing handovers that have breached their SLA, and invalidating CDN-cached pages where a deployment uses one.
